result.summary: Extracts a reusable `sigterm_node` helper and replaces `node.kill_process()` in the `init_fd_overflow_test` functional test with a graceful SIGTERM shutdown. It also consolidates process group keyword argument handling and uses `node.wait_until_stopped()` to verify node termination.
result.problem: Abruptly killing the node process in `init_fd_overflow_test` causes llvm-symbolizer broken pipe errors when resolving UBSAN suppressions during process termination in sanitized test environments.
evidence: PR description quotes fixing #36388: 'llvm-symbolizer broken pipe complaints by replacing the unclean Bitcoin Core shutdown with a clean one in init_fd_overflow_test'
Commit message notes this avoids 'complaints from the llvm-symbolizer about a broken pipe when it resolves UBSAN suppressions during a process kill'
result.scope_notes: Small refactor in test framework utilities and a single functional test.
result.card: This PR refactors test node shutdown by extracting a reusable sigterm_node helper and switching init_fd_overflow_test from an unclean kill to a graceful SIGTERM termination. Unclean kills caused broken pipe errors from llvm-symbolizer when resolving UBSAN suppressions during test execution in sanitized test environments. The change resolves issue #36388 by giving the process an opportunity to shut down cleanly and resolve symbols without error.

risk.why: A flaw in shutdown handling could cause the functional test to hang or fail spuriously in CI.
